en.headline: M+ Myths and Monsters exhibition continues through April at West Kowloon
en.dek: The special show tracing 200 years of fantasy imagery across Asia, from 19th-century mythology to manga and digital culture, remains on view at the museum until 4 April 2027.
body: M+ is presenting Myths and Monsters: The Art of Fantasy in Asia, a special exhibition that opened on 17 October and runs until 4 April 2027 at the West Kowloon museum.

The show explores how artists across Asia have used fantastical stories, characters and worlds to respond to changing social and political conditions, spanning contemporary art, architecture, fashion, video games and film.

It includes more than 400 works arranged in four thematic and chronological sections, with pieces linked to Godzilla, Astro Boy, Ultraman, Ghost in the Shell and Final Fantasy alongside contemporary artists.
General admission to M+ is HK$190 for adults and HK$100 for concession holders. The museum is normally closed on Mondays.

zh.headline: M+「神話與怪獸」展覽延續至明年4月 西九展出亞洲奇幻視覺文化
zh.dek: 博物館特別展覽橫跨200年亞洲奇幻影像，由十九世紀神話到漫畫及數碼文化，展期至2027年4月4日。
body: 西九文化區M+博物館正展出特別展覽「神話與怪獸：亞洲的奇幻異境」，於10月17日開幕，展期至明年4月4日。
展覽探討亞洲藝術家如何運用奇幻故事、角色及世界回應社會政治轉變，涵蓋當代藝術、建築、時尚、電子遊戲及電影。
展出逾400件作品，分為四個主題及時序展區，包括與哥斯拉、小飛俠阿童木、超人、攻殼機動隊及最終幻想相關的展品，以及當代藝術家作品。
M+一般入場成人票價190元，特惠票100元。博物館逢周一通常休息。
